convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for AroonHornSign indicator and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position management, money management, and trade execution logic

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime calculation for trade open time

other_exits: Historical bar scan: if both open and close enabled with no current close signal, scans historical bars from SignalBar+1 forward to find the first opposite Aroon signal to set close flag

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum from TradeAlgorithms.mqh: LOT=fixed lot size, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus losses, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus losses. Positive MM value interpreted as fraction for margin modes, as lot size for LOT mode

custom_logic_notes: Signal bar is configurable (default=1, previous bar). The EA scans AroonHornSign custom indicator buffers: buffer 1 = Up signal (buy), buffer 0 = Down signal (sell). A secondary historical bar scan (lines 131-158) checks if opposite-side close signals should be generated when no direct close signal exists on the current signal bar — this only runs when both BuyPosOpen+BuyPosClose or SellPosOpen+SellPosClose are enabled and no close signal was found on the signal bar. Close signals from opposite Aroon signals: UpValue triggers SELL_Close, DnValue triggers BUY_Close. The Recount mechanism retries reading indicator buffers on failure. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input booleans gate which directions are traded and closed. GlobalVariableDel_ from TradeAlgorithms.mqh cleans up on deinit.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementing AroonHornSign indicator logic (Aroon Up/Down with signal generation). TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar) must all be reimplemented in Python. The margin mode enum has 5 modes that affect lot sizing. SL/TP are in points (not pips), need conversion based on symbol digits. The historical bar scan for opposite close signals adds complexity beyond simple signal-based exit.
